newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC eyes foreign exploration projects.
newsitem.headline: PNOC eyes foreign exploration projects.

text.p: State-controlled PNOC-Exploration Corp (PNOC-EC) said on Thursday it would pursue several oil and gas exploration projects abroad.
"We should have something concrete by the third quarter," PNOC-EC chief operating officer Rafael del Pilar told reporters when asked which projects the company was considering.
Potential sites in Iran, Sudan, Indonesia and Bangladesh had been identified, he said.
Negotiations have started with foreign drillers, one of which was Malaysia's Petroliam Nasional Berhad, for possible tie-ups, he said.
PNOC, which is yet to foray into foreign soil, is initially eyeing minority stakes of at least five to 10 percent in different exploration projects.
The company recently received a formal approval from the trade and industry and foreign affairs departments for its foreign investments.
